subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- August 16, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - August 16, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

We're excited to share the latest developments from the AcreetionOS project. Our community has been actively contributing to the project, and we're grateful for their efforts. One of the recent contributions is the re-triggering of the GitLab mirror, which has been fixed with a deploy key fix. This ensures that our mirror stays up-to-date and reflects the latest changes in our codebase.

In other news, we've added a welcome message for first-time contributors to our CI/CD pipeline. This message aims to make the onboarding process smoother and more welcoming for new contributors. We believe that inclusivity and community engagement are essential to the growth and success of our project.

The Python Software Foundation has announced the candidates for the Python Packaging Council. This is an exciting development for the Python community, and we're eager to see the outcome of this election. We're also keeping an eye on the latest security updates from AlmaLinux and Debian, which include fixes for various vulnerabilities.

Domas has published a proof of concept that bypasses memory protection using AMD's memory controllers. This is an interesting development in the field of security research, and we're following it closely. In other news, we've made some commits to our codebase, including updates to our newsletter and wiki guides, as well as a fix for our logo.

We've also made some changes to our GitLab mirror, including re-triggering it with a deploy key fix. This ensures that our mirror stays up-to-date and reflects the latest changes in our codebase. Additionally, we've made some commits to our AcreetionOS-archiso repository, including a fix for the mirror to a valid GitLab project path.

In the Acreetion-appstore repository, we've added a settings system, AUR sidebar toggle, grid view, and AppImage auto-register. These features aim to improve the user experience and make our appstore more user-friendly. We're also working on syncing our mirror to source and resolving the newest release with assets for the Media Writer download button.

We're grateful for the contributions from our community and look forward to seeing what the future holds for AcreetionOS. If you're interested in contributing to the project, please don't hesitate to reach out. We're always happy to welcome new contributors and help them get started.

As always, we're committed to providing a secure and private Linux distribution that meets the needs of our users. We're proud of what we've achieved so far, and we're excited to see what the future holds.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're grateful for your support and look forward to continuing to work together to create a better Linux distribution.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
